event.elara_heart2.1.text: A hoe blister, the spring crop. Ten a week come through that door. Hold still. There. ...Your hands are cold. Everyone's are, this week. Strange spring! Wool helps. Wool always helps.
event.elara_heart2.1.why: unaware noticing of a village-wide chill, warmth intact

event.elara_heart2.3.text: Oh! Don't look behind the kettle. ...Fine. It's a map. Everywhere I haven't been yet. Dr. Penn looked at it once and got very quiet. She's usually only quiet at paperwork.
event.elara_heart2.3.why: hint seeding the heart8 Harrow Wood clue via Penn's silence

event.elara_heart5.3.text: The map behind the kettle has a friend now. A list. Someday I'll show you. ...You keep watching the door. It's only Dr. Penn's shoes in the hall. I know her footsteps by heart.
event.elara_heart5.3.why: she mirrors the player's unease and comforts it

event.past_the_point.1.text: Felix explained floating very kindly, so I knitted a life jacket! It goes over the real one. For morale! Morale's been scarce on shore lately. Sea air fixes that. Nurse's orders!
event.past_the_point.1.why: keeps the gag, names the shore's low mood without explaining it

event.elara_heart8.intro.text: Shut the door a minute. ...Actually, shut it properly. There. Remember the shy list behind the kettle? The doodles are brave now. Brave enough for both of us. Don't laugh. ...Laugh a little.
event.elara_heart8.intro.why: frightened band; her bravery offered as cover for the player's

dlg.elara.list.1.text: Forty-one places I've never been. Forty-two, once. Dr. Penn inked one out. Harrow Wood. She pressed hard enough to dent three pages. ...Say something before I roll it back up.
dlg.elara.list.1.why: clue tier: Penn crossed off Harrow Wood; prompt job kept

event.elara_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday! And you look like you need it more than I do. New plan: cake, then a nap in the good chair. Both medicinal! Come in, come in!
event.elara_birthday.intro.why: frightened band: the party bends to care for the player

event.elara_courtship.intro.text: Made you a scarf. Mind the end, it trails. The last row is a question: would you court me? In red. ...Your hands are shaking worse than my needles. Scarf first. The question keeps. You matter more.
event.elara_courtship.intro.why: the ask survives; her gentleness answers the player's dread

dlg.elara.partners.0.text: Dr. Penn gave me the afternoon off. She said 'go,' then 'now,' then 'home before dark.' Five whole words! A record! How do we spend them?
dlg.elara.partners.0.why: hint: Penn's too-exact care, the home-before-dark rule, read as fussing

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1.text: Eleven hours yesterday, Dr. Penn. And out again at midnight! I counted. So I knitted you a sleeping mask.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l1.why: hint: Penn abroad at midnight; 'Eleven hours' hinge preserved for her 'It was twelve'

event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.text: I won't! Nineteen, twenty! The fish are quiet today. Even the gulls went polite. I'll knit louder, then!
event.overheard_felix_elara_3.l4.why: uneasy: the quiet birds, met with knitting; answers Felix's fish line

adds.text: You flinched before I touched you. That's not a blister thing. Tea first. The kettle outranks the whole clinic. Sit.
adds.why: she sees the player's fear and treats it like any patient; fills the cut joke's beat

adds.text: You keep looking back at the shore. The sea's the other way! Here. Sandwich. I prescribe horizon, twice daily.
adds.why: the frightened player watches the land; she turns them to the open water

cuts.why: the Penn banter joke falls flat at frightened; the add after .2 carries the beat

notes: elara_garden_visit left untouched on purpose: it plays spring 2 year 1, before any dread or lore gate can be true, and the first knock should be pure warmth at every setting.
No branchy ({if}) lines were varied; all heart8/birthday/courtship/partners 'after' branches stay cozy-only, so no cozy branch meanings are at risk.
elara_courtship2 shares dlg.elara.courtship.* with elara_courtship; only the courtship intro got a frightened variant, so the shared nodes stay single-sourced.
Locked hinges untouched or preserved: 'Eleven hours' kept verbatim in the odalys_3 variant, 'surprise', 'friends', and the past_the_point pencil stroke (event.past_the_point.3) not varied.

The heart8 clue treats Harrow Wood as a former forty-second entry so the shipped 'forty-one places' count stands (and keeps matching Dorian's forty-one trees); if the Director wants it among the forty-one, I will reword.
As unaware, every slip is reported as ordinary village oddness; nothing is explained, nothing names the woods' business.
